items.title: Generic points of the support and embedded associated points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a coherent module F on a locally Noetherian scheme X, the generic points of irreducible components of Supp(F) are associated points of F, and an associated point is embedded exactly when it is not such a generic point; in particular an embedded point of X is an associated point of X which is not a generic point of an irreducible component of X (source lines 381-395). The proof recalls that the support is closed, cites that its generic points are associated points, cites that the associated points lie inside the support, and combines these with the fact that the support is a sober space, so that every point of it is a specialisation of a generic point.
